content.title: 人物装备归属｜局部切片到全身动作
content.summary: 人物与工具先同框，再逐项核对细节，最后用一次动作证明归属。

quick_start.input_format: 人物＋工具＋三个细节＋一次完整动作
quick_start.recommended_input: 一名明确成年的女性雪崩搜救训练员；石板灰和橙色工装、左肩无线电、右手手套、同一支无品牌探杆。训练坡面与标记区全程不换。
required_anchors: 人物与工具先建立关系
动作和全身姿态回证归属
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 人物与工具先同框，再逐项核对细节，最后用一次动作证明归属。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: Introduce a stable person and their tool together, briefly isolate several owner-tool details, then connect those clues through one coherent body-tool action and a broad resulting stance. The source shows the face and tool early; the ending confirms action ownership rather than revealing a never-seen identity.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable tool owner before using close inserts.
invariants.purpose: Gives every later grip or equipment crop a clear subject anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without an established owner, close inserts could belong to several people and the action connection fails.

invariants.rule: Keep tool geometry and attachment to the same person consistent through detail views and the main action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the action legible as one carried object, not a sequence of swapped props.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the tool or its hand changes between crops, the final action cannot be causally traced.

invariants.rule: After the action, show a broad enough pose to confirm where the tool ended relative to the owner.
invariants.purpose: Supplies a spatial outcome for the detail-and-action montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the edit ends on another isolated detail, the viewer cannot verify the final tool-owner relation.

slots.name: subject_role
slots.constraint: One original stable tool owner; when human, visibly adult. Preserve body, costume and handedness across all views.

slots.name: tool
slots.constraint: One role-appropriate non-branded tool with stable shape and grip location.

slots.name: environment
slots.constraint: An original environment with persistent geography and a legible surface or target for the tool action.

slots.name: main_action
slots.constraint: One physically readable owner-tool action, not copied sword choreography.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A broad owner-tool anchor, selective inserts, one action view, and a confirming pose; exact source cuts are not copied.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: Original action-linked ambience and contact sound, not a claim about unheard source audio.

slots.name: medium
slots.constraint: Visual medium may be live action, stop motion or another original form while owner-tool continuity remains legible.

anti_copy_exclusions: No source anime face, hair, pale glowing coat, butterfly ornaments, blade pattern or exact color scheme.
No source sword choreography, exact cut cadence, character identity, creator text or prompt wording.
No franchise marks, source username, logo or weapon violence in the transferable preset.

instantiations.concept: An adult avalanche-rescue trainee plants one search probe into a marked snow-training patch after boot, radio and tool details.
instantiations.prompt_seed: In a realistic snow-safety training area, one adult worker carries a single probe; inserts establish its owner before one insertion and a final full-body gear check.

instantiations.concept: A stop-motion clockwork repair puppet tightens one loose carousel wheel with a small wrench, then the carousel turns while puppet and wrench remain in a wide tabletop view.
instantiations.prompt_seed: On an original miniature clockwork stage, establish one adult-coded repair puppet and its one wrench together; preserve the grip through a few inserts and one continuous wheel-tightening action, then reveal the moving carousel and owner-tool result in a wide pose.

failure_modes.failure: Tool changes shape or hand between inserts.
failure_modes.repair: Define one tool, one owner and one handedness; carry each through the action and end view.

failure_modes.failure: The action is replaced by unrelated flashy cuts.
failure_modes.repair: Reserve one uninterrupted cause-and-effect view at the point where the tool is used.

failure_modes.failure: The ending omits the owner or tool.
failure_modes.repair: Hold a broad final pose that makes both visible in their resultant relation.

transfer_tests.concept: An adult avalanche-rescue trainee plants one search probe into a marked snow-training patch after boot, radio and tool details.
A stop-motion clockwork repair puppet tightens one loose carousel wheel with a small wrench, then the carousel turns while puppet and wrench remain in a wide tabletop view.

review.method: Chinese interface editorial pass with canonical English Creative DNA preserved after translation service rate limit
